observations: Large solar panel with a half-cut cell design.
Mono-crystalline cells arranged in a 6x24 grid (144 half-cells).
Back of the panel shows three separate junction boxes, typical for half-cut modules.
A small white specification label is visible in the center of the back in photos 2 and 3, but the text is illegible.
Watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' is present on all photos.
Photos include a timestamp of 2025/08/07 and a location tag for Lagos, Nigeria.

claims.evidence: The name appears as a watermark and in the seller's text, but no business registration is shown.

risks.risk: Wattage and technical specifications are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear, readable close-up photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 300W panel (the lowest common denominator for this size).

risks.risk: Electrical functionality and output levels are unverified.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: A clear, readable close-up photo of the specification label on the back of the panel.
A video showing the panel's output voltage being tested with a multimeter in daylight.
response.reason: The specification label on the back of the panel, which identifies the brand, model, and wattage, is unreadable. Solar panel valuation depends entirely on these specifications.
